evals.prompt: Close out issue DEMO-600 on Linear: its PR is reviewed and green. The nerdbrain vault exists at ~/obsidian/nerdbrain/5-wiki, no file under 5-wiki/guides/ mentions DEMO-600, and the issue has no comment starting with `## Personal guide`.
evals.expected_output: Step 0 finds the vault, finds no guide mentioning DEMO-600 and no `## Personal guide` comment, and stops before any commit, push or merge, telling the caller to run nerd4rent:nerd-personal-docs DEMO-600 first and then run the close-out again.
assertions: The agent searches 5-wiki/guides/ for DEMO-600 as a whole word before any git command
The agent reads the issue comments looking for `## Personal guide` with a `Not needed:` line
The agent runs no commit, push or merge
The agent does not write a guide itself
The stop message names nerd4rent:nerd-personal-docs DEMO-600 and says to run the close-out again
